title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.28905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact. translated_title: 扩散语言模型智能体之间的隐藏消息：潜在通信的因果证据
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过一系列可修订的连续状态来形成答案，但多智能体系统通常会丢弃这些状态，只在解码出文本后才让智能体之间进行通信。我们探究一条独立的扩散轨迹能否将一条紧凑的隐藏消息传递给另一条轨迹，以及至关重要的是，接收方是否使用了该消息所表达的含义。在Hidden Messages方法中，发送方将其去噪状态压缩为四个带符号的稠密向量；接收方在保留自身上下文、画布和轨迹的同时使用这些向量。移除消息可以检验该通道是否重要；用来自另一个示例的消息替换它可以检验其内容是否重要。在受控任务中，错位替换使Tiny-A2D上+63.6分的优势和Dream-7B上+100.0分的优势消失，而定向替换则会将接收方引导向被替换的事实。在QASC任务中，当两个支持事实被拆分给不同智能体时，匹配的通信（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Hidden Messages方法，让发送方扩散语言模型将去噪状态压缩为四个带符号稠密向量传递给接收方，并通过移除与替换实验提供了因果证据，证明接收方确实利用了隐藏消息的语义内容，从而实现智能体间的潜在通信。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Hidden Messages, where a sender diffusion language model compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors passed to a receiver, and provides causal evidence through removal and substitution experiments that the receiver genuinely uses the semantic content of these hidden messages, enabling latent inter-agent communication.
